reason: A multi-agent orchestration plugin that plans tasks with GPT, executes repository changes through DeepSeek workers, reviews incremental Git diffs, and supports adaptive parallel scheduling and vision input.

summaries.zh: 通过 GPT 规划、DeepSeek 工作代理执行和独立审查来编排多智能体任务，并支持增量 Git 检查、并行调度与图像输入。
summaries.en: Orchestrates multi-agent tasks with GPT planning, DeepSeek worker execution, independent review, incremental Git checks, adaptive parallel scheduling, and image input.

capabilities: Orchestrates GPT planning, DeepSeek worker execution, independent review, and repair rounds
Dispatches concurrent worker tasks based on a dependency DAG and token or concurrency limits
Invokes configured OpenAI-compatible provider routes, including vision-capable models
Enables workers to make incremental repository changes through child agent sessions
Reads workspace Git state and incremental diffs for review
Provides browser settings for planner, worker, reviewer, vision, and scheduling configuration
